vibes.label: Happy
vibes.description: Bright and bouncy: upward leaps, a hook that comes back, a firm ending.

vibes.label: Sad
vibes.description: Slow and falling: long notes, sighing figures, minor color; may not fully resolve.

vibes.label: Pop
vibes.description: Catchy and singable: one short syncopated hook, repeated with small changes.

vibes.label: Mysterious
vibes.description: Sparse and modal: creeping half-steps, space between notes, open endings.

vibes.label: Dissonant
vibes.description: Tense and unsettled: tritones, chromatic clashes, jagged leaps, no easy resolution.

vibes.label: Jazzy
vibes.description: Swung 8ths over 7th chords: chord-tone arpeggios, chromatic approach notes.

vibes.label: Swingy
vibes.description: Bluesy swing: short riffs repeated call-and-response, blue notes, laid-back feel.
